name: Vid-Share
responsibilities: Engineered a real-time video ingestion pipeline to transcode incoming streams into HLS segments for live playback.
Optimized live transcoding configurations to minimize video processing delay during stream ingestion.
Implemented a 50-second watchdog mechanism to detect stalled streams, terminate orphaned transcoding processes, and automate resource cleanup.
Automated thumbnail uploads to object storage with 7-day authorization token validity.

name: Short-Url
responsibilities: Built a low-latency URL redirection service targeting sub-50 ms p99 redirect latency through in-memory lookups.
Implemented atomic short-ID generation to prevent identifier collisions.
Configured automatic link expiration with configurable lifetimes ranging from 60 seconds to 24 hours, eliminating the need for scheduled cleanup jobs.

name: Task-Management
responsibilities: Developed RESTful APIs to manage tasks, assignments, and shared collaboration workflows.
Enforced role-based access control to restrict task deletion to creators while permitting authorized assignee updates.
